lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar gaakharo sa(n)jam kaun chhutio ree ||
lines.translation: How have you escaped from the treachery of sexual desire, anger and egotism?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar dev asur trai guneeaa sagalo bhavan lutio ree ||1||
lines.translation: The holy beings, angels and demons of the three qualities, and all the worlds have been plundered. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: daavaa agan bahut trin jaale koee hariaa boot rahio ree ||
lines.translation: The forest fire has burnt down so much of the grass; how rare are the plants which have remained green.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aiso samarath varan na saakau taa kee upamaa jaat na kahio ree ||2||
lines.translation: He is so All-powerful, that I cannot even describe Him; no one can chant His Praises. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaajar koth mahi bhaee na kaaree niramal baran banio ree ||
lines.translation: In the store-room of the lamp-black, I did not turn black; my color remained immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ma(n)tr gur hiradai basio acharaj naam sunio ree ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru has implanted the Maha Mantra, the Great Mantra, within my heart, and I have heard the wondrous Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh nadar avalokan apunai charan lagaaee ||
lines.translation: Showing His Mercy, God has looked upon me with favor, and He has attached me to His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: prem bhagat naanak sukh paaiaa saadhoo sa(n)g samaaee ||4||12||51||
lines.translation: Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have obtained peace; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am absorbed into the Lord. ||4||12||51||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:
That red dress looks so beautiful on your body.
Your Husband Lord is pleased, and His heart is enticed. ||1||
Whose handiwork is this red beauty of yours?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan ra(n)g too(n) bhaee gulaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whose love has rendered the poppy so red? ||1||Pause||
You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tum ghar laalan tum ghar bhaag ||2||
lines.translation: Your Beloved is in your home; good fortune is in your home. ||2||
You are pure and chaste, you are most distinguished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) preetam bhaanee tuhee sur giaan ||3||
lines.translation: You are pleasing to Your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ||3||
I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red color.
Says Nanak, I have been totally blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun ree sakhee ih hamaree ghaal ||
lines.translation: Listen, O companions: this is my only work;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: prabh aap seegaar savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||52||
lines.translation: God Himself is the One who embellishes and adorns. ||1||Second Pause||1||52||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
I suffered in pain, when I thought He was far away;
but now, He is Ever-present, and I receive His instructions. ||1||
My pride is gone, O friends and companions;

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam gaiaa gur pir sa(n)g meree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: my doubt is dispelled, and the Guru has united me with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
My Beloved has drawn me near to Him, and seated me on His Bed;
I have escaped the clutches of others. ||2||
In the mansion of my heart, shines the Light of the Shabad.
My Husband Lord is blissful and playful. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: masatak bhaag mai pir ghar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: According to the destiny written upon my forehead, my Husband Lord has come home to me.
Servant Nanak has obtained the eternal marriage. ||4||2||53||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
My mind is attached to the True Name.
My dealings with other people are only superficial. ||1||
Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: alipat rahau jaise jal mahi kaulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh kee baat sagal siu karataa ||
lines.translation: By word of mouth, I talk with everyone;
but I keep God clasped to my heart. ||2||
I may appear utterly terrible,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sagal charan kee ihu man raalaa ||3||
lines.translation: but my mind is the dust of all men's feet.
Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru.
